title: watcher_error
description: A streaming watcher died; it also prints a watcher-error line, so a crash is never silent. The --once modes the factory loop uses never log it. Housekeeping. Written by: queue-watch.sh, pipeline-watch.sh in --stream mode (actor watcher). Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

note.description: For people: <watcher>: <reason>, for example pipeline-watch: no-mistakes not on PATH. No reader parses it.
